name: nat-fork-legacy-receipt-aliases
description: native-host.ts:203 fork notes canonicalize legacy receipt aliases before resolving their source: a parent session saved without Posthorse state read the notes through a symlinked alias path and the real path; the fork resolves one source and the private copy is read; a parent that also read a second store has an ambiguous source root, which the next fork reports (extension_error).

rpc.message: Read legacy.md in the ambiguous child.

setup: mkdir -p alias/.pi other/.pi/notes && ln -s "$PWD/.pi/notes" alias/.pi/notes && printf "different store" > other/.pi/notes/legacy.md
